slice.reason_for_selection: r288 left external witness creation unresolved and explicitly prioritized an already-exposed Chat-native action over hypothetical installation. Gmail is the strongest exposed standards-based messaging candidate that could in principle create an independently hosted dated record without generic HTTP POST.
observations: The exposed Gmail connector includes send_email, which requires explicit recipient and subject fields and is contractually restricted to cases where the user wants the message sent now.

Gmail follows the current global plugin permission mode 'Allow low-risk actions'; this mode may deny actions involving sensitive information and does not establish unconditional unattended write availability.

No message was sent in this slice because the role has no user instruction to send email and performing an external side effect merely to manufacture witness evidence would violate the action contract.

An ordinary email record is not a cryptographic append-only public timestamp commitment: mailbox messages can be deleted, and ordinary message Date/Message-ID metadata does not by itself prove trusted append-only existence at a particular time.
slice.tested_scope: Current exposed Gmail send_email action schema and current Gmail plugin permission mode only; no email mutation, no other connector write, no public web research, no O/downstream/other-worker semantics, no scheduler mutation, no protected execution, no finite paid quota, no incremental cost.
